chapter.verse: Kumpi Herod a khan lai, Judea gam Bethlehem khua ah Jesu a suah khit ciangin, en un, nisuahlam pan mipilte Jerusalem hong pai uh a,
“Jew kumpi dinga hong suakpa koi ah om ahi hiam? Ama' aksi hong dawk ka mu uh a, a bia dingin kong pai uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Hih thu Kumpi Herod in a zak ciangin lungbuai a, Jerusalem bup zong tua bang mah ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin Herod in Jew siampi liante leh laisiamte a vekun kaikhawmin Khris koi ah hong suak ding cih thu dong hi.
Tua mite in, “Judea gam Bethlehem khua ah suak ding hi. A hang pen kamsangpa in hih bangin na gelh hi, ci uh hi:
‘Judah gam Bethlehem khua aw, Judah makaite lakah a neupen na hi het kei hi. A hang pen keima' mipawl Israel a cing a kem dingin nangma' sungpan makai khat piang ding hi.’”
Herod in zong mipilte a simthamin sam a, aksi a dawk hun dongcian hi.
Tua ciangin Bethlehem khua ah tua mipilte sawlin, “Pai unla, naupang beltak va kan un. Na muh uh ciangin kei zong pai-in ka va biak theih nadingin thu hong zasak un,” ci hi.
Kumpipa' thugen a ngaih khit uh ciangin mipilte paikhia uh a, en un, aksi hong dawkkhiat lai-a a muh pen uh mah amau' mai-ah na pai a, naupang' omna tungsan a tun ciangin khawl hi.
Aksi a muh uh ciangin mipilte nakpi nuamin lungdam mahmah uh hi.

Inn sungah lut uh a, naupang leh a nu Mary a muh uh ciangin boksukin amah bia uh hi. A vanmanpha bungte uh hongin kham, lingnai paknamtui leh singnai paknamtui cih bangin citpiak vanlenate luui uh hi.
Tua ciangin Herod' kiangah ciahkik lo dingin mang sungah hilhphawnna a ngah mah bangun lampi dang tawnin a gam uhah ciah uh hi.

Mipilte a ciah khit, en un, Joseph a mang sungah Topa' vanmi khat kilang a, “Tho in. Naupang leh a nu tonpih inla Egypt ah tai in. Kong genkik mateng tua gam ah omsuak in. A hang pen Herod in naupang susia nuamin a zong ding hita hi,” ci hi.
Amah zong tho-in zanpi mah naupang leh a nu tonpihin Egypt ah paikhia a,
Herod' sih dong tua mun ah omsuak hi. Hih pen kamsangpa tungtawnin Topa' gensa ahi “Egypt panin ka Tapa ka samkhia hi,” cih thu a tangtun nading ahi hi.

Herod in mipilte' khemna tuak ahihlam a kitheih ciangin heh mahmah a, mipilte kianga a dotcian hun tawh kizui-in Bethlehem leh tua kual bup sunga om naupang pasalnote kum nih gual leh a nuaisiah khempeuh that dingin mi sawl hi.
Tua pen kamsang Jeremiah' gen, a nuai-a thu a tangtung ahi hi:
“Ramah ah awging khat kiza a, kahna leh nakpi tamlawhna hi; A tate hangin Rachel kap a, amaute om nawnlo ahih manin kihehnep ding amah ut lo hi.”
Herod a sih ciangin, en un, Egypt gama om Joseph a mang sungah Topa' vanmi khat kilang a,
“Tho in. Naupang leh a nu tonpih inla Israel gam ah ciah in. A hang pen naupangno' nuntakna a lak sawmte si ta uh hi,” ci hi.
Amah zong tho a, naupang leh a nu tonpihin Israel gam ah ciah hi.
Ahih hangin Herod' tapa Archelaus, a pa' za luahin Judea gam ukin om cih thu a zak ciangin tua gam pai ngamlo a, mang sungah zong hilhphawnna ngah ahih manin Galilee gam ah kihemkhia hi.
Nazareth a kici khua khat ah pai-in tua khua ah teeng hi. Tua pen amah Nazareth khuami kici ding a ci kamsangte' thugen a tangtun nading ahi hi.
